svg.title: The LD Store's pairs, chr22:20-32 Mb, HGDP+1kGP EUR, to scale
svg.desc: Upper triangle of the pair matrix. A band up to 3 Mb from the diagonal holds every pair (Near Band); 3 to 10 Mb holds only pairs with r squared at least t_far (Far Pairs, dots are a sample of the real ones); beyond 10 Mb nothing is measured. One variant's row is contiguous; its column is one element in each earlier row.
svg.text: every pair ≤ 3 Mb apart, exact r
in each of the rows 3 Mb before it
later variant of the pair (Mb, GRCh38 chr22)
earlier variant: the row that stores the pair (Mb)
Below the diagonal: the same pairs again, never stored. HGDP+1kGP EUR, MAC ≥ 20, 65,035 variants; dots: 1,200 of the real Far Pairs.
